title: Linearity of expectation
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, let $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, and let $f,g:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$. Then $\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[af+bg]=a\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[f]+b\mathbb{E}_{\pi}[g]$.
hypotheses_covered: real-valued functions $f,g$ on the sample space
